title: Second affine moment derivative at zero
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $r,c\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The second derivative expression at $t=0$, defined as the average over $x\in\Omega$ of $r(r-1)c^2X(x)^2(1+ctX(x))^{r-2}$, equals $r(r-1)c^2$ times the average of $X(x)^2$.
